mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.title, i.price, i.original_price, i.condition_level, i.status, (SELECT ii.image_url FROM item_images ii WHERE ii.item_id = i.id ORDER BY ii.sort_no ASC LIMIT 1) AS cover_image_url, i.campus_id, c.name AS campus_name, i.category_id, cat.name AS category_name, i.favorite_count, i.view_count, i.published_at FROM favorites f JOIN items i ON i.id = f.item_id LEFT JOIN campuses c ON c.id = i.campus_id LEFT JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = i.category_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC
